message.text: Searching for the backend function that handles the SignIn RPC and its file path.

q04.
APIV1Service.SignIn — server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go

The gRPC method is implemented as `func (s *APIV1Service) SignIn(...)` in that file; the Connect adapter in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` only forwards to it.
